lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਈਆ ਕਟਿਅੜਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil bhaieeaa kaTiaRaa jamakaal ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the humble beings, O Siblings of Destiny, the Messenger of Death is conquered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਹੋਆ ਖਸਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib man vuThaa hoaa khasam dhiaal ||
lines.translation: The True Lord and Master has come to dwell within my mind; my Lord and Master has become Merciful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pooraa satigur bheTiaa binasiaa sabh ja(n)jaal ||1||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, all my worldly entanglements have ended. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere satiguraa hau tudh viTahu kurabaan ||
lines.translation: O my True Guru, I am a sacrifice to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਤੁਸਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere dharasan kau balihaaranai tus dhitaa a(n)mirat naam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. By the Pleasure of Your Will, You have blessed me with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin too(n) seviaa bhaau kar seiee purakh sujaan ||
lines.translation: Those who have served You with love are truly wise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tinaa pichhai chhuTeeaai jin a(n)dhar naam nidhaan ||
lines.translation: Those who have the Treasure of the Naam within emancipate others as well as themselves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਆਤਮ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur jevadd dhaataa ko nahee jin dhitaa aatam dhaan ||2||
lines.translation: There is no other Giver as great as the Guru, who has given the gift of the soul. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aae se paravaan heh jin gur miliaa subhai ||
lines.translation: Blessed and acclaimed is the coming of those who have met the Guru with loving faith.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sache setee ratiaa dharageh baisan jai ||
lines.translation: Attuned to the True One, you shall obtain a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: karate hath vaddiaaieeaa poorab likhiaa pai ||3||
lines.translation: Greatness is in the Hands of the Creator; it is obtained by pre-ordained destiny. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach karataa sach karanahaar sach saahib sach Tek ||
lines.translation: True is the Creator, True is the Doer. True is our Lord and Master, and True is His Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸਚੋ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: sacho sach vakhaaneeaai sacho budh bibek ||
lines.translation: So speak the Truest of the True. Through the True One, an intuitive and discerning mind is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਏਕ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੯੮॥
lines.transliteration: sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa jap naanak jeevai ek ||4||28||98||
lines.translation: Nanak lives by chanting and meditating on the One, who is pervading within and contained amongst all. ||4||28||98||
